messages.author: Helene Aurbakken
messages.text: Grant SF-88121 (DE/FR) runs out on the 22nd — inside the renewal horizon, it does not count. The Canada grant is still waiting on Stillframe's countersign.

messages.author: Priya Raghunathan
messages.text: Pricing ships on v3.2; PIN-5100 holds the three other active consumers. If anyone wants v4.0 on pricing this week that is an exception request to me, not pre-approved.

messages.author: Idris Bello
messages.text: Edge lane 3 PM on the 20th is the summer-teaser blackout. Not movable.

messages.author: Kwame Osei
messages.text: Whatever date we commit at the review has to be real.
